events.parsed:
Soft gray light spills through the windowpane,
The rooftops hum a gentle, steady rain;
Warm coffee steams while puddles start to grow,
The sleepy world awakens, calm and slow.

With whirring gears it tries to sway,
Its metal feet in stiff ballet;
But code gives way to rhythm's chance,
And circuits hum the joy of dance.

Alone it waits upon the greasy tray,
A cheesy prize that no one dares to claim;
We circle it like wolves, but look away,
Too polite to eat it, all the same.
